en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with cobblestone pavement. Along one side stand several 2–3‑storey buildings with shops at street level and a central town hall featuring a small clock tower and cupola. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the open market square. The title text in red at the top identifies the scene as the market square and town hall in Wurzen, Saxony, Germany. Shop signs are visible on the ground floors of the buildings.
